 Some of the coolest temperatures of the season for this weekend 
 Cooler temperatures will continue to move into our area By John Dolusic Published : Oct. 16, 2026 at 6:43 PM EDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google Saturday and Sunday: This weekend we will see the coolest temperatures of the season so far. We will see our overnight low temperatures drop off down into the 40s with wind chills down into the 30s on our Saturday morning. We will see some 30s for air temperatures on our Sunday morning, most areas will hover around 40 degrees. Due to this drop in temperatures and the winds calming down on Sunday morning, do not be surprised to see a few towns with frost. All of this will be due to the dominance of Canadian high pressure. Due to this dominance we will stay dry all the way through the weekend.
 Next week: We will see a gradual warming trend in store for our area as we go through our next work week. We will see the high temperatures reach into the 70s and 80s. Most of the overnight lows will warm up through the 40s and into the lower to middle 50s by later in the week. All of this under dry conditions as high pressure continues to dominate our forecast.
